components.name: Scrub field
components.description: Scrub field — numeric value you change by dragging across the field (tool UI, settings panels). React: <ScrubField label value unit min max step onChange />. Drag = change value (cursor ew-resize), click / Enter = type (Focus), Shift = ×10 step, ↑↓ = step. Track width shows (value − min) / (max − min); resize the Track layer on instances. Neutral track (fill/soft-hover → fill/soft-pressed).

Usage
• Drag horizontally anywhere on the field to change the value; cursor is ew-resize (9.2 Cursor).
• Click or press Enter to type an exact value; Enter / blur commits, Esc cancels.
• Shift + drag or Shift + ↑↓ = ×10 step; Alt = ×0.1 step. ↑↓ change by one step while focused.
• Show the unit whenever the number alone is ambiguous (px, %, ms).
• On touch, horizontal drag fights page scroll — use L, drag only on the track, offer tap-to-type; for counts prefer 3.9 Stepper.
